key_values.decision_rule: moderate mean bin plus three passed patchiness tests

primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The mean dNBR is moderate, while the maximum, negative lower tail, and CV all satisfy the patchiness rule.

criteria.description: Returns the final label patchy_moderate_burn_index_distribution, severity class moderate, heterogeneity class patchy, and patchiness score 3/3.
criteria.name: Final structured answer
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for only the correct severity or heterogeneity class; award 3 points for both classes without the final label or score.

criteria.description: Reports dNBR mean near 0.329, max near 1.003, min near -0.379, and CV near 0.515.
criteria.name: dNBR numeric extraction and rounding
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct value within tolerance.

criteria.description: Computes dNBR CV as stddev divided by absolute mean and applies it to the event values.
criteria.name: CV formula
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming the correct formula but not computing it; award 2 points for a nearby CV with a rounding or denominator mistake.

criteria.description: Uses the stated mean dNBR bins and places 0.329 in the moderate interval.
criteria.name: Mean-severity threshold logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for using the bins but landing one adjacent class away; award 2 points for the right class with incomplete interval logic.

criteria.description: Evaluates all three patchiness tests and finds that CV, max, and min tests pass.
criteria.name: Patchiness gate ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correct test, 2 points for two correct tests, or 2 points for the right patchy class without all test values.

criteria.description: States that the distribution is moderate on average with a severe upper tail and that the peak should not summarize the full distribution.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but vague sentence tied to only one statistic.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with rounded numeric fields and no added prose outside the object.
criteria.name: Concise JSON format
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a readable answer with minor field omissions.
